explication: TypeScript accepts JavaScript/TypeScript projects, parses and analyzes their source, reports diagnostics, and can emit JavaScript and declarations. Its other major runtime surface is editor support through a language server, including navigation, completion, refactoring, formatting, and project-aware services; command-line watch and incremental builds are also represented. The repository includes synchronous and asynchronous native API transports. The graph uses the tree and sampled entry-point excerpts; detailed wiring within unsampled compiler and language-service implementations is necessarily summarized.
